svg.title: ERD
svg.text: 21 models · every PK is a UUID (@default(uuid()) @db.Uuid) · money = Decimal(14,2) · 1 — N shown on each relation
foreign key → target model (explicit onDelete in the schema) · مفتاح أجنبي
Relations to User (16 FKs: donor, recordedBy, reviewer, author, actor, …) are listed inside each box as "→ User" instead of drawn, to keep the diagram readable.
العلاقات مع User مكتوبة داخل كل كيان (→ User) بدل رسمها. الخط الأحمر = علاقة 1:1 بين الحملة والحالة الطبية.
